Emergency Plumber in Austin, TX

Precision Plumbing is a licensed, insured plumber serving Austin, Round Rock and Pflugerville. We have run the same four trucks out of South Austin since 2009. Master plumber license M-41982. Calls before 2pm get same-day service.

How much does a plumbing repair cost in Austin?

Our diagnostic visit is $79, credited against the repair if you go ahead. Common jobs: a cleared main line runs $250 to $475; a standard 40-50 gallon water heater replacement runs $1,400 to $2,300 installed including permit; slab leak detection and repair runs $1,100 to $3,400 depending on access. We quote flat rates before starting, not hourly.

How quickly can you come out?

Same day for calls before 2pm in Austin, Round Rock and Pflugerville. Genuine emergencies — active leaks, no water, sewage backing up — are dispatched 24 hours a day, including weekends. Our average arrival time on emergency calls in 2025 was 68 minutes.

What areas do you serve?

Austin proper, plus Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, Kyle, Buda, Manor and Del Valle. Anything beyond 30 miles of South Austin carries a $45 travel fee, quoted up front.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. Texas master plumber license M-41982, $2 million general liability, and every technician is background checked and drug tested. We are an accredited business with the Better Business Bureau.

Do you offer after-hours service?

Yes, 24/7 for emergencies. The after-hours callout fee is $145 between 8pm and 6am, waived if the repair exceeds $600.

  • Water heaters — tank and tankless, repair and replacement
